dedupe_keys.name: global database of cement production assets and upstream suppliers

description: The Spatial Finance Initiative and collaborators publish a global cement-plant database with linked upstream suppliers. Zenodo hosts two CSVs and a README under CC0, with the source Dryad DOI in its metadata. The asset table describes location, operating status, integrated or grinding type, process, capacity, start year and ownership. The supplier table links plant identifiers to supplier-country and mine-coordinate fields. These tables can support industrial asset exposure, material-flow and supply-dependency simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this two-table release. Coverage is a global compiled inventory with mixed underlying disclosure and geolocation evidence, not a measured shipment or annual production-flow dataset. A limitation is that README cells may contain n/a when evidence was unavailable, and plant capacity is not actual utilisation. Supplier locations and plant ownership may change after this release. The older 2021 SFI asset snapshot is reviewed separately. No CSV was downloaded or plant coordinate checked.
